name: Hasselblad XPan

frameFormat.passage: Images can be captured on 35mm film in two different sized formats. A conventional 24x36mm size and a panoramic 24x65mm. The format setting can be changed anytime even mid-roll.

notes: The one camera in the catalog where the panoramic frame is the native one rather than a mask. The gate is 24x65mm and the Fujinon lenses were computed to cover it, so selecting the standard frame crops down from the full gate. That is the inverse of the Trip Panorama 2 and the Espio 120Mi, which are full frame with a mask that drops in, and both stay FULL_FRAME.

year.passage: It is available for $99 and is expected to ship out starting the first week of December 2025.

name: Kodak Cameo Auto Focus QD

year.passage: KODAK CAMEO Auto Focus Camera. Released: 1994. Off market: 1996.

notes: The dated listing is for the KODAK CAMEO Auto Focus Camera. QD is the quartz-date back on that same body, and no reference database dates the QD separately, so this is the body's year rather than the variant's.
